row.title: A moved Cloudflare zone shell cannot be deleted right after a registrar move
row.body: After an inter-account registrar move, the losing account's zone goes to status moved and DELETE /zones returns code 1315, from the API and the dashboard alike. Empty its DNS records (email sending subdomains and routing DNS first, they lock MX/TXT records) and let the probe report the shell until it is purged.

title: A moved Cloudflare zone shell cannot be deleted right after a registrar move
